about: SYNTHETIC drift fixture (D2d). The layer STRUCTURE is invented to simulate one drift shape of an ArcGIS layer against the FL seed field map; every VALUE is derived from the FL golden county's recorded attributes (shared/landData/golden/fl-golden-county.json) by the ops in values.derive — no value is invented.
drift: AV_NSD and JV both removed; JV_AV_NSD (holding the AV_NSD values) and JV_2026 (holding the JV values) appear. JV_AV_NSD is a near match for BOTH missing fields and JV has two equal candidates — greedy assignment must not hide that ambiguity by taking one candidate off the table before the other field is scored.
